instructions.text: Verification must be done using a standard reference thermometer and a test thermometer. Deviation should not be larger than 0.5°C — if it is, complete REC 7.10.4 to add a correction factor.
instructions.label: Verify thermometer accuracy

instructions.text: Crush ice, fill half a jar, top up with water and stir. Insert reference probe and test thermometer, wait to stabilise, then record.
instructions.label: Cold verification (0–5°C)

instructions.text: Boil water, insert reference probe and test thermometer, wait to stabilise and record. If the reading exceeds the specified limits, a corrective action must be recorded.
instructions.label: Hot verification (85–95°C)

relatedLinks.label: If deviation exceeds 0.5°C, complete Thermometer Correction Factors to add a correction factor.
